title: Working agreements
body:

title: Release checklist
body:
{"ops":[{"insert":"• Tests green on main.
"},{"insert":"• Preview checked on mobile and desktop.
"},{"insert":"• Environment variables compared with production.
"},{"insert":"• Rollback command written in the PR.
"},{"insert":"• Announce in the deployments channel.
"}]}

title: Client update template
body:
{"ops":[{"insert":"• Done this week.
"},{"insert":"• Planned next week.
"},{"insert":"• Risks or decisions needed.

title: Incident runbook
body:
{"ops":[{"insert":"• Check the status page and error logs first.
"},{"insert":"• Roll back before debugging if customers are affected.
"},{"insert":"• Post a short update in deployments every 30 minutes.
"},{"insert":"• Write a three-line summary afterwards.
"}]}

title: Client onboarding checklist
body:
{"ops":[{"insert":"• Create the shared channel and invite the client contact.
"},{"insert":"• Share the project plan and the first sprint goals.
"},{"insert":"• Agree on one decision maker.
"},{"insert":"• Schedule a weekly 15 minute check-in.
"}]}

title: Outreach learnings
body:
{"ops":[{"insert":"• Short first lines beat long introductions.
"},{"insert":"• Clinics reply the most, logistics need two follow-ups.
"},{"insert":"• Day 4 is the best day for the first follow-up.
"},{"insert":"• Always link one real result.
"}]}

title: SEO basics we use on every site
body:
{"ops":[{"insert":"• One clear title and description per page.
"},{"insert":"• Schema markup for local business and FAQs.
"},{"insert":"• Redirect map before any migration.

"},{"insert":"• Check Core Web Vitals monthly.

title: Estimate checklist
